Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Rohan - 12 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Hema - 42 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Aditi - 8 years, friend
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail
4. Kunal - 8 years, friend
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
5. Kavya - 9 years, daughter
Look: yellow frock, two plaits

Places

1. The terrace - a water tank, a clothes line

Scene 1: The terrace - Day

[Rohan stands on the terrace. Hema stands near him.]

Hema: "What lovely weather!"

[Rohan flies a kite on the terrace.]

Rohan (surprised): "What a day to remember!"
